parts.title: The Legend of the Swamp — Part 1

series.summary: On Whale Island, twelve-year-old Gon Freecss dreams of taking the perilous Hunter Exam, but Aunt Mito forbids it unless he completes an impossible challenge: catching the mythical Lord of the Swamp. Perched in a giant tree with his father's rod, Gon battles the colossal monster fish and lands it before the stunned villagers, proving his unshakable resolve.

segments.voiceover_text: A twelve-year-old boy wagers his future on one impossible catch. Perched high above the swamp, Gon Freecss waits to earn his ticket to the deadly Hunter Exam.
Aunt Mito set an uncompromising rule: catch the mythical swamp monster, or stay home forever. Five grown fishermen failed. She prays the beast never bites.
Suddenly, the lake boils. The line snaps taut. The colossal creature thrashes, violently pulling Gon toward the water, but his grip never falters.
Gon wrenches the titanic beast onto the shore. The crowd is stunned. He won his ticket, but can he survive the painful secret Aunt Mito is hiding?

series.summary: Having conquered the swamp, Gon claims Ging's fishing rod from Aunt Mito. Mito confesses that his father chose the Hunter's life over raising him, expecting tears, but Gon is inspired to discover what makes hunting so magnificent. Promising to return as the greatest Hunter in the world, Gon boards the passenger ship and sets sail toward the open ocean.

segments.voiceover_text: A promised reward uncovers a painful family secret. Aunt Mito surrenders Ging's fishing rod, unable to hide her bitter grief.
She confesses the truth: Ging abandoned his only son because being a Hunter mattered more than family. She expects tears, but Gon is electrified.
Gon clutches the rod with fierce resolve. He must discover what made hunting worth abandoning a child. He vows to become the greatest Hunter alive.
The great vessel departs Whale Island. Gon waves goodbye to cheering villagers, oblivious to the ferocious tempest waiting to swallow his ship whole.

parts.title: The Storm That Breaks the Weak — Part 3

series.summary: Out on the turbulent sea, a ferocious storm violently rolls the passenger vessel, incapacitating dozens of hopeful applicants with agonizing seasickness. Amid the groaning wreckage in the hold, only Kurapika, Leorio, and Gon remain totally unaffected. Observing the cabin, the grizzled sea Captain recognizes their extraordinary resilience and summons them into his quarters.

segments.voiceover_text: Black skies and towering waves turn a routine voyage into a nightmare. Violent winds hammer the wooden hull, threatening to tear the vessel apart.
Below deck, pure agony reigns. Brutal rolling swells slam dozens of muscular applicants into the walls, leaving them puking and sobbing in helpless seasickness.
Yet three strangers remain totally unaffected. Kurapika calmly reads in his hammock, Leorio lounges with an apple, and energetic Gon rushes to nurse the suffering.
The grizzled Captain strides through the ruined cabin, stunned by the only three survivors still standing. He orders them to his quarters, hiding a ruthless test they never anticipated.

series.summary: In the captain's quarters, the Captain reveals he is an official examiner and demands to know why each candidate seeks to become a Hunter. Kurapika explains his tragic mission to avenge the massacred Kurta clan and retrieve their stolen Scarlet Eyes, while Leorio brazenly insists money is all that matters. Enraged by Leorio's cynical disrespect, Kurapika challenges him to a duel out on the stormy deck.

segments.voiceover_text: Behind closed cabin doors, the Captain delivers a chilling ultimatum. He is an official examiner, and refusing to state their true motives means immediate disqualification.
Kurapika reveals his tragic burden: he is the last survivor of the Kurta clan, seeking retribution against the Phantom Troupe who slaughtered his family for their Scarlet Eyes.
Leorio scoffs at the tragedy, loudly insisting that raw cash is the only goal that matters. Kurapika takes deep offense at his cold cynicism, glaring with pure contempt.
Tempers violently erupt. Insulted by Kurapika's disdain, Leorio demands an apology and challenges him to settle their dispute with blood out on the tempestuous deck.

parts.title: Blades Drawn in the Tempest — Part 5

series.summary: Out on the rain-lashed deck, Kurapika unholsters his twin wooden swords while Leorio flicks open a switchblade. As lightning flashes and their blades prepare to clash, a monstrous rogue wave breaks the rigging and hurls a young deckhand into the churning sea. Without hesitation, Gon leaps completely off the ship into mid-air, risking his life to grab the falling sailor.

segments.voiceover_text: Torrential rain batters the open deck as two furious rivals square off. Neither man is willing to yield, and lightning illuminates the raging sea.
Leorio snaps open a gleaming switchblade. Kurapika unholsters his twin wooden swords. Their eyes burn with deadly intent as they prepare to strike.
Before their blades collide, disaster strikes. A monstrous wave snaps the heavy rigging, hurling a young deckhand helplessly toward the churning ocean.
Without hesitation, Gon sprints and hurls himself into the open abyss to catch the crewman, but both are plummeting toward the lethal sea with no lifeline in sight.

parts.title: Plunge into the Raging Abyss — Part 6

series.summary: As Gon and the sailor plummet toward the sea, Kurapika and Leorio lunge over the railing and grab Gon's ankles, pulling them both back to safety. Shamed by Gon's pure bravery, Leorio reveals he wants money to become a doctor after his impoverished friend died, and Kurapika apologizes for misjudging him. Thrilled by their courage and unity, the Captain passes all three applicants.

segments.voiceover_text: Two rivals forget their feud in a heartbeat. Diving to the railing, Kurapika and Leorio catch Gon's ankles, hauling him and the deckhand safely back aboard.
Gon grins, confident they would catch him. Humbled, Leorio confesses his true secret: he wants money to become a doctor after losing his impoverished best friend.
Kurapika softens and sincerely apologizes for misjudging him. Watching their bond form, the Captain bursts into hearty laughter and announces they have passed his test.
The storm breaks as morning light bathes the calm ocean. Once bitter rivals, the three companions stand united, ready to conquer the deadly trials of the Hunter Exam.
